cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Answer the Previous Question
cards.instruction: Redirect every dangerous question by sincerely answering an earlier, safer version of it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. You asked if lunch was good. The soup was excellent.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That was before I asked who ate my birthday cake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Excellent, but slightly salty. I hadn't finished my lunch review.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Forget lunch. Answer about the cake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You also asked where we ate. That deserves a precise answer.

mechanism: A supervises the exact scope of a lunch answer so earlier quality/location questions keep replacing the dangerous cake question.
confusable: D134 evades a key question broadly; D230 must answer a specific earlier safe question sincerely.
comparison: Everyday meal review and family cake accountability differ from accident chronology.
seedUse: Prepare both earlier safe questions in A1 so A5 location is not an invented late escape.
